details.question: How many runs did the Royals score in the final?
details.sql: SELECT season_year, CASE WHEN first_innings_team = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN first_innings_runs ELSE second_innings_runs END AS royals_runs, CASE WHEN first_innings_team = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN first_innings_wickets ELSE second_innings_wickets END AS wickets_lost, CASE WHEN first_innings_team = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN second_innings_team ELSE first_innings_team END AS opponent, winner FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE stage = 'Final' AND (team1 = 'Rajasthan Royals' OR team2 = 'Rajasthan Royals') ORDER BY season_year LIMIT 200

details.question: How many centuries has the Universe Boss scored in IPL history?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(hundreds) AS centuries FROM marts.mart_batting_season WHERE batter ILIKE '%Gayle%' GROUP BY batter LIMIT 200

details.question: Who has scored more career runs in the IPL, Virat Kohli or Rohit Sharma?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(runs) AS career_runs FROM marts.mart_batting_season WHERE batter IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY batter ORDER BY career_runs DESC LIMIT 200

details.question: Between Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings, which team has a better head-to-head win record?
details.sql: SELECT winner, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE ((team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' AND team2 = 'Chennai Super Kings') OR (team1 = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND team2 = 'Mumbai Indians')) AND winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 200

details.question: • How many wickets did Don Bradman take in his debut IPL season?
details.sql: SELECT p.player, p.first_season, SUM(b.wickets) AS debut_season_wickets FROM marts.dim_players AS p LEFT JOIN marts.mart_bowling_phase AS b ON b.bowler = p.player AND b.season_year = p.first_season WHERE p.player ILIKE '%Bradman%' GROUP BY p.player, p.first_season LIMIT 200

details.question: Which player won the Orange Cap in the same season that Sunrisers Hyderabad won their first IPL title, and how many runs did he score?
details.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT MIN(season_year) AS season_year FROM marts.mart_team_season WHERE team = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' AND is_champion) SELECT b.season_year, b.batter, SUM(b.runs) AS runs FROM marts.mart_batting_season AS b JOIN s ON b.season_year = s.season_year GROUP BY b.season_year, b.batter ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 3

details.question: Which franchise has hit the most sixes in a single IPL season, and which player hit the most sixes during that campaign?
details.sql: WITH team_sixes AS (SELECT season_year, team, SUM(sixes) AS team_sixes FROM marts.mart_batting_season GROUP BY season_year, team), top_team AS (SELECT * FROM team_sixes ORDER BY team_sixes DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT t.team, t.season_year, t.team_sixes, b.batter AS top_six_hitter, b.sixes AS batter_sixes FROM top_team AS t JOIN marts.mart_batting_season AS b ON b.season_year = t.season_year AND b.team = t.team ORDER BY b.sixes DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Which bowler won the Purple Cap in the season that Gujarat Titans won their debut IPL title, and which team did he play for?
details.sql: SELECT season_year, bowler, team, SUM(wickets) AS wickets, SUM(legal_balls) AS legal_balls, ROUND(SUM(runs_conceded) * 6.0 / SUM(legal_balls), 2) AS economy FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase WHERE season_year = (SELECT MIN(season_year) FROM marts.mart_team_season WHERE team = 'Gujarat Titans' AND is_champion) GROUP BY season_year, bowler, team ORDER BY wickets DESC, economy ASC LIMIT 3

details.question: What was the home stadium of the team that finished as runners-up in the 2023 IPL season, and which city is it located in?
details.sql: WITH ru AS (SELECT loser AS team FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE season_year = 2023 AND stage = 'Final') SELECT ru.team, m.venue, m.city, COUNT(*) AS matches_in_2023 FROM ru JOIN marts.fct_matches AS m ON m.season_year = 2023 AND (m.team1 = ru.team OR m.team2 = ru.team) GROUP BY ru.team, m.venue, m.city ORDER BY matches_in_2023 DESC LIMIT 3

details.question: Which bowler has claimed more career wickets in the IPL, Yuzvendra Chahal or Jasprit Bumrah?
details.sql: SELECT bowler, SUM(wickets) AS career_wickets FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase WHERE bowler IN ('YS Chahal', 'JJ Bumrah') GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY career_wickets DESC LIMIT 200
